ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Focused Visit (Care-plan review) — Albert Einstein

code.originalText: Six-month aneurysm surveillance with duplex ultrasound

text.paragraph: Mr. Einstein returns six months after his first visit for surveillance duplex ultrasound, done in the vascular laboratory this morning. He has had no abdominal, back, flank, or groin pain, fainting, or leg symptoms. He finished the 7 mg nicotine patch this week and has used only an occasional lozenge, and has had no tobacco for nearly six months. His home blood pressure readings average 122/74. He takes amlodipine, losartan, atorvastatin, and aspirin without side effects. He has booked his eye examination and plans to have his influenza and COVID-19 vaccines at the pharmacy next week. He asked for the numbers in full and wanted to know whether anything in today's results changes the plan agreed in April. [S]

text.paragraph: Guideline basis: The Society for Vascular Surgery practice guidelines on the care of patients with an abdominal aortic aneurysm (2018); 2022 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Aortic Disease (2022); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, Hypertension and Hyperlipidemia monographs (2026); Tobacco Smoking Cessation in Adults, Including Pregnant Persons: Interventions (2021)
